services.name: Set sail
services.desc: Gone Sailing Adventures was founded in 2008 by Howie Colt and started charters in 2010. Gone Sailing Adventures’ fleet includes 9 luxury yachts - 1 catamaran, 5 sailing & 3 motor. All our yachts exceed Transport Canada minimum safety requirements and include a licensed captain and host. Each boat is a brilliant example of modern ship engineering and boasts a superior interior finish. On our larger yachts, there is both covered (bimini) and open areas for those who cannot decide whether they want sun or shade.
